reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DSH 提供本地编辑器集成：通过 open_in_vscode 打开工作区文件/文件夹、跳转到指定行列，并支持两个文件的差异视图查看。证据来自 README 与 package 元信息，且该行为集中于本地文件打开与编辑器启动，而非远程服务、搜索或数据处理。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH 提供 open_in_vscode 工具，可从会话中打开文件或文件夹、定位到指定行列，并可用于两个文件的差异比较。
summaries.en: This plugin provides an open_in_vscode tool for DSH to open workspace files or folders in Visual Studio Code, jump to a target line and column, and open local file diffs.

capabilities: Open local files and folders from a workspace in Visual Studio Code
Jump to a specific line and column when opening a file
Open a diff view for two local files
Optionally wait for the editor window to close before returning
Auto-detect or configure the local Code.exe executable path
Execute a local editor process via direct spawn behavior

reasons.code: README describes a DSH host plugin that registers open_in_vscode and lists file/folder open, line/column jump, diff view, and wait behavior.
Package description and metadata state the plugin directly spawns Code.exe to open local VS Code instances to avoid sandboxed shell blocking.
Repository layout includes dsh plugin manifest and build/package configuration, indicating intended runtime integration with DSH tool execution.
